basic_details.scholarship_name: University of Luxembourg Guillaume Dupaix Master's Excellence Award
basic_details.offering_entity: University of Luxembourg & Luxembourg Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs and Ministry of Higher Education and Research
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: University of Luxembourg (Belval Campus in Esch-sur-Alzette, Kirchberg Campus, and Limpertsberg Campus, Luxembourg)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Faculty of Science, Technology and Medicine (Computer Science, Information Security, Data Science, High-Performance Computing, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics), Faculty of Law, Economics and Finance, and Faculty of Humanities, Education and Social Sciences.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~30 to 45 Guillaume Dupaix Excellence Awards awarded annually to top international master's students
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open internationally; typically 3 to 6 outstanding Pakistani students in computing, fintech, and data science selected annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 24 months (2-year standard Master's degree tenure)
basic_details.monthly_stipend_amount: Total funding package: €10,000 per academic year living stipend (€5,000 per semester / approx. €1,000 / month / ~PKR 300,000 / month) plus guaranteed subsidized student housing in a university hall of residence (worth €400-€550/month) and tuition waiver across all master's semesters

nationality_requirements: Open to non-EU/EEA international students and EU students (Pakistan fully eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No statutory maximum age limit, though priority is given to candidates with high academic momentum.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed recognized 16-year Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) with outstanding academic performance (minimum CGPA 3.50/4.00 or top 10% class ranking) from an HEC-recognized university.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum CGPA 3.50 / 4.00; competitive applicants typically hold CGPA >= 3.70 / 4.00.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Computer science, cybersecurity, information security, data science, financial economics, quantitative finance, mathematics, physics, or mechanical/civil engineering.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or final-year undergraduate students completing degree requirements before September semester start.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Internships or technical experience in software development, cybersecurity, financial technology, or data analysis are advantageous.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.5 (6.0 in all sub-scores), TOEFL iBT minimum 90, Cambridge Advanced (C1), or official English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate from an accredited degree-granting institution.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: French or German proficiency is required only for bilingual master's programs; English-track degrees require English proficiency only.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Open equally to all qualified applicants.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Candidates apply directly to an eligible Master's programme at the University of Luxembourg and submit the Guillaume Dupaix scholarship application dossier.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold another parallel government fellowship covering identical living and tuition costs.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition fee covered or waived (University of Luxembourg tuition fees are standardly €200 to €400/semester, fully covered).

admission_application_fee.details: University of Luxembourg application processing fee of €50 paid online during portal submission.

accommodation.details: Guaranteed university hall of residence room reserved for the scholar, with rental costs (€400 to €550 / month) directly covered or subsidized from the fellowship allowance.

monthly_stipend.details: Living stipend of €10,000 per academic year (€5,000 disbursed per semester / approx. €1,000 / month / ~PKR 300,000 / month) disbursed directly for personal living expenses.

airfare.details: International travel between Pakistan and Luxembourg Findel Airport is self-funded.

visa_fee.details: Luxembourg Temporary Authorisation to Stay (AST) and Visa D application fees (€50) paid to Luxembourg Immigration Directorate.

health_insurance.details: Full statutory enrollment in the Luxembourg National Health Fund (Caisse Nationale de Santé - CNS) covering comprehensive medical, hospital, and dental care.

food_allowance.details: Subsidized university restaurants (Restopolis) across Belval and Kirchberg campuses; student meals cost €3.50 to €5.50.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full access to the Luxembourg Learning Centre (LLC), MeluXina national supercomputer, Interdisciplinary Centre for Security, Reliability and Trust (SnT), and digital research databases.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Generous paid master's thesis research opportunities and industrial partnerships with major European banks, Amazon Europe HQ, and Skype in Luxembourg.

travel_transit_allowance.details: 100% FREE nationwide public transit: All trains, trams, and buses throughout the entire country of Luxembourg are completely free for everyone.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single elite research institution in the heart of the European Union (University of Luxembourg).
participating_institutions: University of Luxembourg (Belval Campus in Esch-sur-Alzette, Kirchberg Campus in Luxembourg City, Luxembourg)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Times Higher Education (THE) World University Rankings Top 250 globally, Ranked #4 in the world for International Outlook (THE 2024); renowned for cybersecurity, fintech, space resources, and multilingual European law.
available_majors: Master in Information and Computer Sciences (MICS)
Master in Information Security and Cybersecurity (MISC)
Master of Science in Civil Engineering - Megastructure Engineering
Master in Quantitative Economics and Finance
Master in Space Technologies and Business
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's degree with CGPA >= 3.50/4.00, academic transcripts, detailed motivation letter, two academic letters of recommendation, CV, and English proficiency certificate (IELTS 6.5+ / TOEFL 90+ / MOI).
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Master in Information Security and Cybersecurity (MISC) and Master in High-Performance Computing (partnered with MeluXina supercomputer) are exceptionally selective; candidates with strong algorithms and systems backgrounds stand the highest chance.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Highlight technical competencies aligned with Luxembourg's national research priorities: European cybersecurity, fintech analytics, High-Performance Computing, or space resource exploration.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the University of Luxembourg admissions portal, complete online application for eligible master's program, select Guillaume Dupaix scholarship, upload statement of purpose, CV, transcripts, and submit by the strict international deadline.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Check program requirements on uni.lu and verify eligibility for Guillaume Dupaix award.
Step 2: Create account on University of Luxembourg admissions portal (open February 1).
Step 3: Complete online admission application and upload Guillaume Dupaix scholarship motivation essay.
Step 4: Upload attested transcripts, degree certificates, CV, and English proficiency proof.
Step 6: Master's programme admission committee evaluates applications and nominates top candidates.
Step 7: University Scholarship Selection Committee reviews nominations and confirms awardees.
Step 8: Official admission and Guillaume Dupaix scholarship offer issued in May.
Step 9: Apply for Luxembourg Temporary Authorisation to Stay (AST), obtain Visa D, and arrive in Luxembourg in early September.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated University Route: Application for master's admission and Guillaume Dupaix award are submitted together via the central admissions portal.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Uploaded directly by candidate as signed official PDF letters on institutional letterhead with referee contact details.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Guillaume Dupaix Motivation Statement (1-2 pages) explaining academic excellence, research ambitions, reason for choosing the University of Luxembourg, and long-term career goals.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Statement of academic focus outlining proposed specialization track and master's thesis interest.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Comprehensive academic CV detailing education, project portfolio, programming skills, and extracurricular leadership.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Online technical video interview via MS Teams or Webex conducted by programme course director for shortlisted candidates.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic 6.5+, TOEFL iBT 90+, or official English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate accepted.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Certified true copies of transcripts and degree certificates; HEC and MoFA attestations required for Pakistani credentials.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified official English, French, or German translation for all non-English documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online submission via University of Luxembourg admissions portal.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Official Academic Transcripts and Degree Certificate
required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete Bachelor's degree certificate and transcripts with grading scale and CGPA >= 3.50/4.00.
Detailed essay (1-2 pages) demonstrating academic excellence, intellectual curiosity, and career roadmap.
Confidential evaluation letters from university professors on institutional letterhead.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Signed and stamped with official university seals.

required_documents_checklist.specification: IELTS Academic 6.5+ (6.0 in all sub-scores), TOEFL iBT 90+, or official MOI certificate.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Official test report or MOI letter.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Comprehensive academic CV detailing education, projects, software proficiencies, and honors.
Clear color copy of passport bio-data page valid for at least 18 months.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Single annual admission cycle for autumn entry; application window open February 1 to late March for non-EU international applicants.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 45% (Undergraduate GPA, academic consistency in major subjects, course rigor)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 25% (Technical project depth, software portfolio, and undergraduate thesis quality)
selection_process_and_weights.work_experience_weight: 5% (Relevant industry internships or software development roles)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Quality, eloquence, and intellectual clarity of motivation statement)
selection_process_and_weights.financial_need_weight: 0% (Pure academic excellence and intellectual merit based)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Faculty Master's Admissions Board and University of Luxembourg Scholarship Committee.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-tier holistic evaluation selecting top 1-2% of global master's applicants displaying exceptional potential.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~1,800 to 2,500 international applicants across Master's programs
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~2.5% to 4.0% for candidates with superior academic records and CGPA >= 3.70
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: Undergraduate CGPA >= 3.70 / 4.00, accompanied by strong programming projects or thesis research
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates in computer science, software engineering, mathematics, or quantitative finance with stellar academic records and clear specialization intent.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates from top Pakistani universities (FAST-NUCES, NUST, LUMS, UET Lahore, GIKI, Quaid-i-Azam).
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, India, Italy, France, China, Germany, Ukraine, Brazil, Turkey.

fake_websites_and_scams: Only apply through official portal uni.lu.
University of Luxembourg never charges additional placement fees or works with unauthorized commercial agents.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Application fee of €50 is paid directly through the secure university online portal.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Commercial agency written statements are disqualified; personal authenticity is evaluated during course director interviews.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Initial pocket money before first stipend disbursement: ~€500 (~PKR 150,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: You need French or Luxembourgish fluency. Reality: All STEM and computing master's programs are 100% in English.
Myth: Housing in Luxembourg is impossible to find. Reality: Guillaume Dupaix scholars are guaranteed university student residence housing.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial sites claim public transport is expensive in Luxembourg; in reality, public transportation is 100% free nationwide by law.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Maintain satisfactory academic progress and complete at least 60 ECTS credits in Year 1 to renew the award for Year 2.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical presence on campus in Luxembourg; residence in reserved university student housing.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual progress review evaluated by Master's study director at the end of the second semester.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Part-time student work permitted under Luxembourg immigration law (up to 15 hours/week during term, 40 hours/week during holidays).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; zero service bond or return obligation (graduates are entitled to a Luxembourg post-study work authorization).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Scholarship is terminated if candidate fails to meet academic milestones, abandons studies, or violates student code of conduct.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Fellowship is strictly limited to 2 academic years (4 semesters); extensions beyond 2 years are not funded.
